title: The Cat Who Came for Tacos by Diana Star Helmer
description:
Novels and Nibbles is featuring a sweet little book about kindness, hospitality, belonging, and welcoming someone new. This sweet little adoption story is about a stray cat, Flynn, who is sleeping on the doorstep at the home of Senor Tomas and Senora Rosa. They eventually invite him in and share their tuna tacos with him, but Flynn must learn the household rules and manners. Eventually, “he settles into a cozy spot and stays - becoming their house cat”.

 “Flynn Tacos” three flour tortillas piled high with blackened yellowfin tuna, seared rare and topped with our own cumin cilantro-lime slaw, smoky chipotle aioli, and fresh cilantro.

Meeeow! So delicious you cannot stop liking your whiskers! Come get your paws on some of these before they are gone.
